inlines.text: Lily normally works a 35-hour week at Coles and is paid $25 an hour.
Calculate her total pay for a week in which she works an additional 4 hours overtime at time-and-a-half.

inlines.latex: \begin{aligned}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Normal pay}} & \textcolor{#24282d}{=}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Normal pay per hour}}\textcolor{#24282d}{\times}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Number of normal hours}}\\ \textcolor{#268cff}{\text{Normal pay}} & =25\times35\\ \textcolor{#268cff}{\text{Normal pay}} & =\$875\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Overtime pay}} & \textcolor{#24282d}{=}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Normal pay per hour}}\textcolor{#24282d}{\times}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Number of overtime hours}}\textcolor{#24282d}{\times}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Penalty rate}}\\ \textcolor{#268cff}{\text{Overtime pay}} & =25\times4\times1.5\\ \textcolor{#268cff}{\text{Overtime pay}} & =\$150\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Total pay}} & \textcolor{#24282d}{=}\textcolor{#24282d}{\text{Normal pay + Overtime pay}}\\ \textcolor{#268cff}{\text{Total pay}} & =875+150\\ \textcolor{#268cff}{\text{Total pay}} & =\$1025\end{aligned}

answer.worked: $$\begin{aligned}\text{Normal pay}&=25\times35=\$875\\\text{Overtime pay}&=25\times4\times1.5=\$150\\\text{Total pay}&=875+150=\$1025\end{aligned}$$

inlines.text: Ben normally works a 35-hour week as a kitchen hand and is paid $18.90 an hour.
Calculate his total wages for a week in which he works an additional 5 hours overtime at time-and-a-half.

answer.worked: $$\begin{aligned}\text{Normal pay}&=18.90\times35=\$661.50\\\text{Overtime pay}&=18.90\times5\times1.5=\$141.75\\\text{Total pay}&=661.50+141.75=\$803.25\end{aligned}$$

inlines.text: Rina normally works a 35-hour week as an analyst and is paid $36.15 per hour.
Calculate her total wages for a week in which she works an additional 3 hours at time-and-a-half and 3 hours at double-time. Round only the total pay to the nearest cent.

answer.worked: $$\begin{aligned}\text{Normal pay}&=36.15\times35=\$1265.25\\\text{Time-and-a-half pay}&=36.15\times3\times1.5=\$162.675\\\text{Double-time pay}&=36.15\times3\times2=\$216.90\\\text{Total pay}&=1265.25+162.675+216.90\\\text{Total pay}&=\$1644.825\\\text{Total pay}&\approx\$1644.83\end{aligned}$$

inlines.text: When Mr Ding first started teaching, he earned $72 000 annual salary.
How much does he get paid per fortnight? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Pay per period}&=\frac{\text{Total pay}}{\text{Number of periods}}\\&=\frac{\$72\,000}{26\text{ fortnights}}\\&=\$2769.23/\text{fortnight}\end{align*}$$

inlines.text: Harry works full-time and earns a salary of $1600 per week.
How much does he earn in a year?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Pay}&=\text{Pay per period}\times\text{Number of periods}\\&=\$1600/\text{week}\times52\text{ weeks}\\&=\$83\,200\end{align*}$$
